about: An observation has a close: what was read before the close is partial and stands for nothing; the readings at or
after it are the observation, and the latest of them is what stands at that coordinate.

cases.name: everything read before the close stands for nothing
the latest reading after the close stands
a reading at the close is inside it

coverage.criterion: everything before the close, the latest after it, and a reading exactly at it
coverage.why: one coordinate; three readings at most
